svg.title: Today's command line tools feed a user-owned CI flow where policy and a person's review come before any write job; dashed parts are yours to build.
svg.desc: Moving figure, 12 seconds, looping, no sound. 1. TRIUNA LABS, INC. · INTEGRATION WALKTHROUGH. From GitHub Actions to a reviewed change. Caller-owned CI runs the scan; policy and people control outbound actions.. Footer: Triuna Labs, Inc. · Architecture walkthrough · Dashed elements are yours to build. 2. Key: a solid frame means Current CLI; a dashed frame means Yours to build; amber tint means A person releases it. 3. Section: CAPABILITIES AVAILABLE NOW. 4. Selected repository. Explicit root or reviewed bounded discovery No implicit device inventory 5. Local scan. Graph + source coverage Commands: scan. No network lookup 6. Optional checks. OSV + npm metadata Commands: enrich; advisory-details. Explicit data sharing 7. Private snapshot. Nodes, edges, findings Commands: snapshot.json. Keep outside public repo 8. Explore + compare. Graph + candidate events Commands: render · diff. No automatic notification 9. Section: USER-OWNED ACTIONS FLOW · COMMANDS AND EXAMPLES IN THE REPOSITORY. 10. Caller workflow. workflow_dispatch or PR, read-only token, actions pinned by SHA Commands: examples/ci/scan.yml. Scans only the checkout 11. Private evidence. RUNNER_TEMP by default, or a private baseline store you choose Commands: summary. Aggregate-only job summary 12. Policy + packet. Freshness, coverage states, stable IDs, redacted packet with a content hash Commands: evaluate · packet. Unknown is not clean 13. Proposal check. Only packet evidence, files, artifacts and advisory IDs; exact target version Commands: check-proposal. Evidence IDs must match 14. A line leads from Your model to Proposal check. 15. Human review, a person decides. Approval bound to the proposal hash and source commit Commands: check-decision. No model self-approval 16. Optional user hook. Webhook example: HMAC, idempotency key, receipts, suppression Commands: notify/webhook.mjs. Off unless configured 17. A line leads from Policy + packet to Optional user hook. 18. Issue adapter, proposed, not built yet. Same pattern as the webhook, with its own narrow token Only the webhook ships 19. Your model, proposed, not built yet. You choose it; none is called by default Should see only the packet 20. A line leads from Policy + packet to Your model. 21. Separate write job, proposed, not built yet. Branch or PR from the reviewed plan, narrow permission A sketch in hitl-remediation 22. A line leads from Human review to Separate write job, marked with a person: it runs only after a person's review. 23. Test + re-scan. Fresh scan and evaluate --previous; no-longer-observed only after a successful check Commands: evaluate --previous. A suggestion is not a fix 24. Boundary: real snapshots, local paths, private package names, and tokens stay in user-controlled storage. Packets carry package names; decide before they leave.. A remote viewer would be a separate authenticated, read-only service; never expose the local folder picker API directly. Optional telemetry spans carry counts and fixed labels, no names, and nothing is exported without an endpoint..
